# Onboarding guide: psf/requests

## What this project is
The `requests` library is a Python HTTP client library designed to make HTTP requests simple and intuitive ("HTTP for Humans™"). It is intended for developers interacting with web services and APIs using Python, abstracting complex protocol details on top of `urllib3`.
